exceptions.rationale: The GET handlers (/inventory, /challenge, /profile) are authenticated by a Cognito bearer token plus the per-session proof header, never by a browser cookie, so a cross-site request cannot carry the credentials. The only write a read performs is the session lastActiveAt touch (DLV-970: one conditional DynamoDB statement, at most once a minute), which CodeQL reports as a state change on GET. Reviewed 2026-11-15; re-review when the handler or the touch changes.

challenge(): the caller token selects the CHALLENGE# item by its SHA-256 digest and every property of the stored item (never of the request) is then checked: cancelled, sign-in generation, expiry, token family and proof binding; any mismatch throws. The user-controlled value only chooses which stored record is checked and cannot skip the check; the PostgreSQL registry selects by the same digest. Reviewed 2026-11-15.

holderOf(): the subject from the verified test-session token looks up the stored holder row; a missing row yields NOBODY (no role, no access) and an existing row role comes from the store, never from the request. The lookup narrows access and cannot widen it; Local and DEV test accounts only. Reviewed 2026-11-15.
